Component descriptions: The following components have usage descriptions or documentation links defined in Figma. These descriptions provide important context about the intended usage, best practices, and any constraints for each component. Follow these guidelines when implementing or using these components.

## Text Content Title
**Node ID:** 2153:7838

Code: TextContentTitle from "primitives" (props: title, subtitle, align). Use once per page as the page heading; it renders the page-level title and subtitle.

## Notification
**Node ID:** 124:8256

Code: Notification from "primitives" (props: variant "alert" | "message", icon, isDismissible; children = content). Use variant="alert" for errors that block an action and variant="message" for confirmations. Keywords: message, alert, feedback, callout, banner

## Text Heading
**Node ID:** 2087:8488

Code: TextHeading from "primitives". Use for section headings inside a page (or TextContentHeading with heading/subheading props).

## Input Field
**Node ID:** 2136:2263

Code: InputField from "primitives" (props: label, description, errorMessage, isInvalid, isDisabled, type, value, onChange). Help text goes in description. Show validation errors with isInvalid + errorMessage; do not render custom error text.

## Switch Field
**Node ID:** 9762:1902

Code: SwitchField from "primitives" (props: label, description, isSelected, onChange, isDisabled). Use for on/off preferences; wrap several in SwitchGroup. A setting that cannot be changed is isDisabled. Keywords: toggle

## Avatar Block
**Node ID:** 2010:15581

Code: AvatarBlock from "primitives" (props: title, description; children = <Avatar initials="A" /> or <Avatar src=... />). Use to show a person with name and secondary text such as email.

## Avatar
**Node ID:** 9762:1103

Initials should be single e.g. A, B, or C, and not multiple e.g. AA, BB, or CC. This is because the widths of the avatars would force the text to overflow outside.

## Select Field
**Node ID:** 2136:2336

Code: SelectField + SelectItem from "primitives" (props: label or aria-label, selectedKey, onSelectionChange, isDisabled; SelectItem id + children). Use for choosing one option from a short list, e.g. a role. Keywords: dropdown

## Button Danger
**Node ID:** 185:852

Code: ButtonDanger from "primitives" (variant "danger-primary" | "danger-subtle", size, isDisabled). Use for destructive actions such as removing a member or deleting data. The regular Button component does not accept danger variants. Keywords: action, negative, destructive

## Button Group
**Node ID:** 2072:9432

Code: ButtonGroup from "primitives" (align "start" | "end" | "center" | "justify" | "stack"). Wrap related actions such as Cancel + Save. Keywords: actions

## Button
**Node ID:** 4185:3778

Code: Button from "primitives" (variant "primary" | "neutral" | "subtle", size "medium" | "small", isDisabled, onPress). One primary action per view; use neutral for Cancel. Destructive actions use Button Danger instead.
The generated code contains image and SVG URL constants, e.g. const image = `${assetPathPrefix}/<asset file name>`, where assetPathPrefix is declared once at the top of the code and every asset URL interpolates it. These URLs are temporary download sources and expire after 7 days. Download each asset into the project with curl -L, then replace its URL in the generated code with a reference to the downloaded asset. Never use the temporary URLs as runtime image sources.
